rule: each dot may move <= 2 px onto the strongest smoothed magnetic-edge response in its window, subject to a 0.25 sigma gain gate and a 2.828 px spacing floor; count, mass and catalogue exclusion unchanged

model.hypothesis: The two magnetic derivatives disagree where one of them is artefact-dominated, so their consensus peak should be the more reliable positional estimate even though it is broader.
model.mechanism: Averaging two edge measures that are sensitive to the same source but to different noise keeps the shared (geological) peak and suppresses the band-specific seam and interpolation artefacts.
model.confounder: Where both bands share one artefact (a flight-line seam distorts every derivative at once) consensus adds no robustness at all.
model.falsifier: cons2 outside the hg2/vg2 spread, i.e. worse than both, would mean the consensus peak lands on a compromise neither band supports.

predicted_live_range: MODEL: live change in [-0.005, +0.015], central +0.005; expected to be the most stable of the three if any of them works.
